title: 12th Day
categoryChain: Everyday short duas in the month of Ramadhan

verses.translation: O Allah, on this day, (please) adorn me with covering and chastity,
cover me on it with the dress of satisfaction and contentment,
encourage me on this day to be just and impartial,

verses.arabic: وَاٰمِنِّي فِيْهِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَا اَخَافُ،
verses.translation: secure me against whatever I fear,
in the name of Your protection, O Shelter of the fearful ones!
